section_summary: This section consists of monthly Southern Ocean whaling grounds maps, beginning with the end of a map started before page 238 and running from March 1937 to March 1941. The maps mark Antarctic coastal regions and use a legend for whale species and numbers observed or caught. There are no named correspondents or prose reports in these pages.
